title: Tom DeLonge email to John Podesta about General McCasland

tellings.quote: Buried in that email dump is an email from Tom Dong to Podesta. The subject line, General McCassland Dong writes, he mentioned he's a skeptic. He's not. I've been working with him for 4 months.

plain: Among the emails of John Podesta, a senior political adviser, that the leak site WikiLeaks published, there is one from the musician Tom DeLonge with the subject line about General McCasland, meaning the Air Force general Neil McCasland. In it DeLonge writes that the general had said he was a skeptic, but he is not, and that DeLonge had been working with him for four months. Michels reads this from the leaked emails, from 2015 to 2016, as a sign that a senior general was quietly helping DeLonge's UFO efforts.
